Entries.Text: Reload the world in the running game from your save, without returning to the title screen. Save your maps first: the game loads them from the game files.
The connection to the running game. It is shared with the Material Editor's Material Reloader and the Text Editor's FMG Reloader.
Save, then reload the same save. Reloading the world reads the maps from the game files.
Reload the game's last save without saving first. Reloading the world reads the maps from the game files.
The game link is busy with another tool: a material or text reload, or a quit out.
